rules.accepted_credit_types: Seminars from RACE, AVMA, AVMA-accredited veterinary colleges, state boards and state VMAs, specialty organizations (e.g. ACVIM, ACVS, AAHA) and regional conferences without prior approval; others may be pre-approved; RACE-approved proctored computer-based training
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE needed before the first renewal that takes place in an even-numbered year.
rules.alternatives: Board may waive CE for licensees on inactive status.
rules.notes: License renews every year on September 30; the 24 contact hours are counted over Oct 1 of an even year to Sept 30 of the next even year and are due with the even-year renewal. Max 6 h practice management.
